tokens.npc_dota_hero_tiny_bio: Coming to life as a chunk of stone, Tiny's origins are a mystery on which he continually speculates.  He is a Stone Giant now, but what did he used to be?  A splinter broken from a Golem's heel?  A shard swept from a gargoyle-sculptor's workshop?  A fragment of the Oracular Visage of Garthos?  A deep curiosity drives him, and he travels the world tirelessly seeking his origins, his parentage, his people.  As he roams, he gathers weight and size; the forces that weather lesser rocks, instead cause Tiny to grow and ever grow.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_tiny_hype: Growing to tremendous size and strength as the battle progresses, Tiny's power can quickly become terrifying. He tosses heroes and creeps at his enemies, or stuns them beneath an avalanche. Should he gather his full strength, he can demolish the enemy's base with ease.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Tiny Toss Visualized icon-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Tiny Toss Visualized icon-2.png|84px]]
*** When unit and area-targeted, the nearest unit within [[Wikipedia:Circle|grab radius]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|Q|21px]] becomes a {{M|projectile}} and is Tossed to the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} targeted unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] and affects other enemy units within the {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location.
**** Requires a targeted unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] for the ability to work.
**** {{M|Runes}} can be unit-targeted, but cannot be Tossed.
**** {{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
***** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||requires no target|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t3l}} removes this restriction, and no longer requires a targeted unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] to Toss a unit.
****** When ground-targeted, the affected unit is now tossed to the {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location.
****** {{M|Runes}} can no longer be targeted upon learing the {{M|talent|t=t3r}}.
*** Can damage other enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Toss type1 value1}}|v1={{#var:Toss cast range}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Tiny Toss Visualized (Unit Target) icon.png|84px]]
*** When unit-targeted, applies a ≈1000-distance {{M|upward movement}} on the affected unit.
*** The {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} grab radius now functions as the unit-targeted cast range, other targeting functionality notes apply.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** Can Toss both enemy and allied units, and {{M|Runes}}.
*** [[File:Dota2 Tiny Toss Grab Action icon.png|21px|Grab]]
**** Can grab the following units:
***** {{M|Allied units|x}}
***** {{M|Fogged}} units.
***** {{M|Untargetable}} ally units.
**** Cannot grab the following units:
***** {{M|Ancient creeps}}.
***** {{M|Buildings}}
***** {{M|Couriers}}
***** {{M|Disable Help}} on Tiny prevents the allied hero from being Tossed if it is the lone valid target within the grab radius.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
**** Cannot be cast on the following units:
***** {{M|Couriers}}.
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
*** The [[projectile]] cannot be {{M|disjointed}}.
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
**** Launches a projectile with a variable speed upon cast.
**** Applies a {{M|Disable|text=disabling}} {{M|forced movement}} that {{M|stuns}} and moves the affected targeted unit periodically with the projectile.
**** Can move over {{M|impassable terrain}} and over {{M|trees}}.
**** The projectile persists upon the affected unit's {{M|death}} and continues traveling until projectile impact.
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Speed}}
**** The [[projectile speed]] ({{Code|S}}) varies accordingly to the landing coordinates ({{Code|L}}) and the unit's current coordinates ({{Code|C}}), and is defined as follows:
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|S {{=}} [[Wikipedia:Absolute value|{{!}}]] L - C [[Wikipedia:Absolute value|{{!}}]] , MAXSpeed {{=}} 2308}}
***** The speed does not instantly adapts, but either accelerates or decelerates at a slow rate whenever the value between {{Code|L}} and {{Code|C}} changes.
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
**** The ability effects are applied as follows upon projectile impact:
****# The impact {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in one damage instance on other enemy units within the damage radius.
****#* {{cf|shdnotes}}
****#** The {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} neither updates the current spell damage and damage radius.
****#** Both the spell damage and damage radius increase does not utilize {{A|Tiny|Grow}}'s ability values.
****# {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
****#* The landing {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} on the unit-targeted enemy.
****# {{Symbol|Trees}}
****#* [[Trees]] within 100 radius centered around the Tossed unit are destroyed.
****# {{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|tiny_toss_land_debuff}}
****#* Directly use {{A|Tiny|Grow}}'s ability values, the ability component is not applied if Grow is not learned upon cast.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|tiny_tree_grab (x)}}
** Reapplying the buff refreshes the number of attack charges.
** Reduces each attack buff charge per successful attack.
** The buff duration lasts until the following conditions:
*** Casting the {{A|Tiny|Tree Throw}} {{M|sub-ability}}.
*** Until Tiny's {{M|death}}.
*** After using up the number of attacks.

* {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
** The ability [[cooldown]] starts upon losing the wielded tree in any way, not upon cast.

* {{Symbol|Trees}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** The ability grants four main components upon cast:
*** All granted ability effects end upon losing the wielded [[tree]].
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus atk}} + {{Symbol|Melee}}
**** Turns Tiny into a [[melee]] unit, and has a [[Attack Range#Set Base Attack Range|set]] {{#var:Tree Grab value4}}-{{M|attack range}}.
***** Does not affect attack range manipulating sources.
***** Items that use different values for the wielder's [[attack range]]-type now considers the caster as a melee unit.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Bonus}}
**** Flat [[bonus attack damage]].
**** This component is functional when {{M|deny|text=denying}} ally units.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Cleave}}
**** Successful attacks applies [[pseudo-cleave]], a unique attack-based area damage.
***** Does not apply the pseudo-cleave when attacking the following units:
****** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
****** {{M|Items}}
***** Deals {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} correspondingly to Tiny's attack damage value, and is defined as:
****** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|CleaveDmg {{=}} [[Attack Damage#Total Attack Damage|ΣAtkDmg]] × {{#var:Tree Grab value5}}}}
****** {{Symbol|Modifier|Flag}} Has the following damage flags:
******* {{M|No-spell-lifesteal}}
******* {{M|No-spell-amplification}}
***** Affected by {{M|damage block}} sources on the enemy individually within the area-of-effect.
***** Does not affect the following units:
****** {{M|Buildings}}
****** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
***** Stack independently with other {{M|cleave}} sources.
**** {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{hi|Tiny}} [[File:Dota2 Tiny Tree Grab Visualized icon-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Tiny Tree Grab Visualized icon-2.png|84px]]
***** The total ability area-of-effect consists of two components, and starts at Tiny current location, from point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|O|21px]] to point [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|F|21px]]  , and can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Tree Grab value1}}+{{#var:Tree Grab value2}}}}-distance away with the area damage length and width.
****** [[File:Dota2 Tiny Tree Grab Visualized icon-3-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Tiny Tree Grab Visualized icon-3-2.png|84px]]
******* Square [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|O|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] has a {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Tree Grab value1}}-length with a {{#expr:{{#var:Tree Grab value2}}*2}}-width.
****** [[File:Dota2 Tiny Tree Grab Visualized icon-1-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Tiny Tree Grab Visualized icon-2.png|84px]]
******* The semi-circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|F|21px]] is after the square area, and has {{#var:Tree Grab value2}}-radius.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|4|21px]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Conditional}} {{to}} {{Symbol|bonus buildings}}
**** The [[buildings]] bonus attack damage is a bonus [[conditional attack damage]] sources and has the following properties:
***** The bonus values are directly added to Tiny's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}} and not displayed in the [[HUD]].
**** Does not interact with the following sources:
***** Percentage-based {{M|bonus attack damage|x}} sources.
**** Interacts with the following sources:
***** {{M|Damage block}} sources on the buildings itself.

abilities: Toss + Avalanche combos a single target for huge early burst and saves allies.
Tiny is melee with no escape, so any reliable stun pins and kites him.
items: Linken's Sphere blocks Tiny's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Tiny's magic damage and disables.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Tiny's targeted disable.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Tiny for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Tiny's physical attacks.
Glimmer Cape's magic resistance and fade help dodge Tiny's burst.
Spell immunity to fight through disables and magic.
A gap-closer to stick to targets.
An invis burst that breaks enemy passives.
An upgraded Blink with bonus attack speed.

sourceRecord: Toss + Avalanche combos a single target for huge early burst and saves allies.
Tiny is melee with no escape, so any reliable stun pins and kites him.
Linken's Sphere blocks Tiny's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Tiny's magic damage and disables.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Tiny's targeted disable.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Tiny for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Tiny's physical attacks.
Glimmer Cape's magic resistance and fade help dodge Tiny's burst.
Spell immunity to fight through disables and magic.
A gap-closer to stick to targets.
An invis burst that breaks enemy passives.
An upgraded Blink with bonus attack speed.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_tiny
data.bio_loc: Coming to life as a chunk of stone, Tiny's origins are a mystery on which he continually speculates.  He is a Stone Giant now, but what did he used to be?  A splinter broken from a Golem's heel?  A shard swept from a gargoyle-sculptor's workshop?  A fragment of the Oracular Visage of Garthos?  A deep curiosity drives him, and he travels the world tirelessly seeking his origins, his parentage, his people.  As he roams, he gathers weight and size; the forces that weather lesser rocks, instead cause Tiny to grow and ever grow.
data.hype_loc: Growing to tremendous size and strength as the battle progresses, Tiny's power can quickly become terrifying. He tosses heroes and creeps at his enemies, or stuns them beneath an avalanche. Should he gather his full strength, he can demolish the enemy's base with ease.
data.npe_desc_loc: Grows in size and strength as battle ensues

abilities.name: tiny_avalanche
abilities.desc_loc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

abilities.name: tiny_toss
abilities.desc_loc: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
abilities.lore_loc: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
notes_loc: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_grab
abilities.desc_loc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
abilities.lore_loc: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
notes_loc: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_channel
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
abilities.lore_loc: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.

abilities.name: tiny_insurmountable
abilities.desc_loc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_loc: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

abilities.name: tiny_grow
abilities.desc_loc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
abilities.lore_loc: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
abilities.shard_loc: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

abilities.name: tiny_toss_tree
abilities.desc_loc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
abilities.lore_loc: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_tiny_5
talents.desc_loc: Toss can target the ground as well as enemy units.
